task.pr_title: Allow setting custom server and key with env variables

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Honestly, `crate::get_custom_rendezvous_server(get_option_("custom-rendezvous-server")).is_empty()` has bug, you last change fixed the bug, but we need to get rid of duplication.

evidence.thread_resolution:
botanicvelious: I believe this would work here, as the reason it seemed to me that it didn't work was because the configuration value wasn't set, this checks both the config value as well as the env var being set so that should cover every case? Could just check the env var i suppose but then the message would show up if someone put in a config value, i am still testing everything however to see if i missed anything
rustdesk: `crate::get_custom_rendezvous_server(get_option_("custom-rendezvous-server")).is_empty()` is buggy, because there is another way to define `cutom rendezvous server` in addtion to `custom-rendezvous-server` option. Comparing pub key is the most safest and simplest way. SInce you are modifing here, I hope you can fix this bug together. :)
botanicvelious: I added a default key option and used that, should resolve the issue
